learning_objective: 🎯 Uncover the epic story of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and the Peshwas, who used brilliant military tactics to build a massive empire across India!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj was a visionary leader who carved out a powerful Maratha state from the declining Adil Shahi sultanate. He built strong hill forts and a disciplined army.

The Marathas were experts at guerrilla warfare (hit-and-run tactics). Because they knew the rugged Western Ghats perfectly, they could launch surprise attacks on larger Mughal armies and quickly retreat to their hill forts.
Shivaji was not just a warrior; he was an excellent administrator. He set up a council of eight ministers known as the 'Ashtapradhan' to help him govern the empire fairly and efficiently.
After Shivaji, the Peshwas (Prime Ministers) became the real power behind the Maratha Empire. Under their leadership, the Maratha cavalry expanded the empire's borders all the way to northern India.

fun_activity.title: ⚡ Build Your Own Fort
fun_activity.instructions: Shivaji's strength lay in his hill forts. Use pillows, cardboard boxes, or blankets to build a model 'hill fort' in your room, and imagine how you would defend it from invaders!

quick_recap: ⭐ Shivaji Maharaj established a strong Maratha kingdom using brilliant administrative and military strategies.
⭐ Guerrilla tactics gave the Marathas a huge advantage over the slow-moving Mughal armies.
⭐ The Peshwas expanded Maratha power, making them the most dominant force in 18th-century India.
